name: Radius
description: Border-radius scale used for corner rounding across every component. Previously had no foundation spec file even though `borderRadius` is a first-class top-level token category in tokens.json and is referenced by name (radius.sm, radius.full, ...) throughout every component spec - added to close that gap.

full.usage: pill buttons, toasts, avatars, toggle tracks/thumbs

usage: corner radius - always use a named token, never a raw number
notes: docPage is null, not "/foundation/radius" - no doc page exists for this foundation yet. There is no src/app/(docs)/foundation/radius directory on disk; every other foundation has a real one. Building the page is out of scope here (src/app/ is owned by another agent this round) - this field just needs to stay honest until it's built.
